claim: Primary X'02' is unassigned in the System/370 instruction code table; an unassigned operation code is handled as an operation exception.

sources.title: System/370 Reference Summary, Sixth Edition
sources.evidence_note: The instruction column is blank for hex 02; rows 04, 05, and 06 identify SPM, BALR, and BCTR respectively. This also prevents misidentifying X'02' as BCTR.

sources.title: IBM System/370 Principles of Operation, Seventh Edition
sources.evidence_note: Program-interruption rules define an unassigned/invalid operation code as an operation exception.
